title: Which Successes Make Good References? Action-Sequence Alignment for Multi-Turn On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2611.13135v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) reduces train-inference distribution mismatch by supervising a student on its own trajectories. For multi-turn tool-use agents, conditioning the teacher on a validated same-task successful trajectory as a reference can provide useful hindsight, but different successes may reach incompatible interaction states and offer misleading supervision. We cast successful-reference selection as a free-target optimal transport problem, which reduces to assigning each failed trajectory its most compatible successful reference. Because latent state paths are hidden, we use action-sequence alignment as an observable proxy for compatibility and instantiate it with longest common subsequence (LCS), which identifies a shared ordered backbone of actions while allowing recoverable detours. translated_title: 哪些成功案例能成为好的参考？面向多轮在线策略蒸馏的动作序列对齐方法
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）通过在学生模型自身的轨迹上进行监督，来减少训练与推理之间的分布失配。对于多轮工具使用智能体而言，让教师模型以经过验证的同任务成功轨迹作为参考，可以提供有用的后见之明；但不同的成功案例可能到达不兼容的交互状态，从而提供误导性的监督信号。我们将成功参考的选择问题形式化为一个自由目标的最优传输问题，即把每条失败轨迹分配给与其最兼容的成功参考。由于潜在的状态路径是隐藏的，我们采用动作序列对齐作为兼容性的可观测代理，并用最长公共子序列（LCS）加以实现——LCS能够识别出共享的有序动作主干，同时允许可恢复的绕路。这一视角使轨迹兼容性成为多轮OPD中参考选择的核心准则。在ALFWorld上的实验……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文将多轮在线策略蒸馏中的成功参考选择建模为自由目标最优传输问题，并提出以最长公共子序列（LCS）为基础的动作序列对齐作为轨迹兼容性的可观测代理，为每条失败轨迹匹配最兼容的成功参考，从而避免误导性监督、提升蒸馏效果。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates successful-reference selection in multi-turn on-policy distillation as a free-target optimal transport problem, using LCS-based action-sequence alignment as an observable proxy for trajectory compatibility to assign each failed trajectory its most compatible successful reference, thereby avoiding misleading supervision and improving distillation.
